messages:
alex: Heads-up: saw a 3x latency spike on /v1/embeddings this morning for a few tenants. Root cause looks like giant mixed-dim payloads causing backpressure and spilling into our slow path.

maria: Ugh. Any correlation with batch size or a particular model? :eyes:

jordan: looks correlated with requests that have >120 vectors and mixed dims (768 + 2048). the splitter is falling back to single-item routing and we hit the slow quantized path.

alex: exactly. throughput drops; tail latency explodes. I sampled logs and saw 413s from downstream then retries causing queues.

sam: Does the console show which tenants? can we surface this as an SLO incident automatically?

alex: console flagged a per-route latency alert but it was noisy. we need a more targeted signal: embargo when per-tenant preflight failures + queue depth > N.

maria: proposal: add a lightweight circuit breaker for the embeds route at the ingress that trips on preflight failure rate + moving-average latency. On trip, it fastfails or routes to a costlier but bounded fallback with explicit quota.

jordan: +1. We should avoid global trips — tenant-scoped circuit only. Also emit a telemetry event with dims histogram so we can build a dashboard.

lee: telemetry fields needed: dims_distribution, vector_count, total_payload_bytes, preflight_result (ok/mismatch/oversize), route_taken (fastpath/slowpath/fallback), and circuit_state.

alex: agree. sample event shape: ```
X-Embed-Dims: [768, 2048]
vector_count: 132
total_bytes: 1_048_576
preflight: mixed-dim
route: fallback-slowpath
circuit: closed
```

maria: for the circuit thresholds: start conservative. trip if preflight_mismatch_rate > 10% AND p99_latency > 2s for 5m window. Untrip after 15m stable.

dave: also consider soft-degradation: when near threshold, return a `prefer-small` header recommendation to clients and a `Retry-After` with an estimated window. That improves UX rather than immediate hard fail.

jordan: +1 to soft-degrade. We can add a response header `X-Embed-Suggest-Split: true` and an explanation code like `split_hint=per-tenant`.

sam: console UX: we need a per-tenant SLO panel showing circuit status over time, counts of fastfail vs fallback, and a landed action to whitelist/blacklist fallback for enterprise tenants. Also a button to force-close the circuit for support ops.

lee: for telemetry retention: index dims distribution and aggregate to daily buckets. raw events at 7d, aggregates for 90d. dashboards will need sample histograms and a quick query to find top offending tenants.

alex: rollout plan: feature-flag the circuit-breaker and telemetry. phase 1 -> emit telemetry only (2 weeks). phase 2 -> enable circuit for 5% tenants via flag and monitor. phase 3 -> ramp to 100% with console controls.

maria: add contract change to preflight API: clients can opt into `preflight: full` to get explicit split suggestions in response. default stays `preflight: basic` to avoid breaking. document in SDK changelog.

jordan: tests: unit for threshold math, integration test that simulates mixed-dim payloads and verifies route changes, and load test with 100k vectors to ensure circuit trips gracefully.

ops-bot: deploy-candidate alex/circuit-breaker -> staging started (build 42).

lee: ops question: for telemetry schema, prefer `route_taken` values to be enumerated strings so dashboard filters work. e.g., ["fastpath","splitter","fallback_slow","fallback_batched"].

alex: noted. also add `quota_signal` (none/soft/strict) when trips happen.

maria: security: ensure any new headers don't leak tenant ids or PII. strip them in logs.

jordan: edge case: some SDKs send embeddings as nested base64 arrays; preflight needs to parse quickly or we will add parsing CPU overhead. consider a quick preflight checksum that client can add to avoid parsing server-side.

alex: good point — add `X-Embed-Client-Hint` header schema: shape hint, dims, count. We'll accept it as advisory; we still validate.

sam: ops checklist for rollout: alert thresholds, dashboard tiles, feature flag config, migration docs, SDK changelog, runbook for forced-untrip.

lee: packed list of telemetry KPIs to emit: trip_count, trip_duration_ms, preflight_mismatch_rate, fallback_ratio, p50/p95/p99 latency per route, top-ten tenants by trip_count.

maria: action items: alex -> prototype circuit + telemetry (PR this week), jordan -> test harness, lee -> telemetry schema, sam -> console panel mock, dave -> SDK hint spec. I'll schedule a quick sync on Friday to review flags.

alex: working on PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/1234 (draft). comments welcome.

jordan: will add load test script to infra-tests repo and tag @maria when ready.

maria: thanks all. if we can get telemetry first we'll at least know scale before flipping breakers. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-candidate alex/circuit-breaker -> staging succeeded (build 42).

alex: staging telemetry looks good. initial histograms show 0.7% mixed-dim requests >100 vectors, but they cause 40% of p99 latency.

maria: that ratio alone justifies the circuit. moving to phase 2 canary next week unless objections.

lee: no objections from telemetry side. I'll prepare dashboard widgets and saved queries.

sam: I'll schedule the Friday sync; invite list updated.

alex: closing loop — will open a follow-up thread with rollout notes once canary runs.
